explanation: Generated one EXCLURAD eta-channel input file containing the requested 3x3 grid (9 points). All points passed preflight at the eta campaign default beam energy of 6.53 GeV, using vcut=0.166 GeV^2 and full O(alpha) radiative corrections. The beam energy was not specified by the requester; 6.53 GeV is the validated eta-channel campaign default and should be stated when reporting results because radiative corrections depend on beam energy.
